props.name: highlights
props.description: Phrases to mark. A string marks every match; `{ text, occurrence }` marks only the nth.

props.name: animate
props.description: Blur the text in and sweep the highlights when it scrolls into view.

props.name: direction
props.description: The side the sweep starts from.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds from entering view to the first sweep.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each sweep takes; the blur-in takes the same.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between one highlight's sweep and the next.

props.name: blur
props.description: Starting blur in pixels, before the text is in view.

props.name: inactiveOpacity
props.description: Starting opacity, before the text is in view.

props.name: once
props.description: Play once, or reset each time the text leaves view.
